tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should furnish the reference where similar Work made

Must have minimum turnover of Rs. 10.00 lakhs during previous three financial years and documentary proof /certification from a Chartered Accountant in support of the same as audited profit & loss account/balance sheet will have to be provided.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer should be a registered Company or Partnership/ Proprietorship/Manufacturers /dealers firm having a valid GST registration and Copies to be enclosed.
The bidder shall furnish the address of the Head Office, Branch Office and the Works (Factory) with contact Nos., email id etc.
